claim: In the matching retail DLL, the two conditional helpers left opaque by FACT-0039 are closed together. PlayerController_AI.IsEffectiveFall (0x06004FE9) is a parameterless instance method returning Boolean with an exact 111-byte body: it resolves the target Player and current MatchSetting, returns false when MatchSetting.VictoryCondition equals raw 3 or raw 4, returns false when PlObj.Zone equals raw 1, then returns true only when both PlObj.hasRight and target.hasRight are nonzero. Player.mEquExistCehck (0x06004F1D) is an instance method with one SkillSlotEnum parameter named slot returning Boolean with an exact 22-byte body: it loads WresParam.skillSlot[slot] and returns true when that Int32 element is nonzero, false when zero. FACT-0039 pins IsEffectiveFall at IsLotPriorityAct IL+0x00D6 and mEquExistCehck at IL+0x011F, 0x0168, and 0x01F9.
